svg.desc: A decision ladder of seven questions. Sorted input leads to two pointers or binary search; a contiguous window to a sliding window; seen-before or counts to a hash map; top-k to a heap; overlapping ranges to sort-and-sweep; graphs to BFS, DFS or topological sort; overlapping subproblems to dynamic programming.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Which pattern? Ask in this order

svg.text: The first “yes” is usually the pattern. Then state its cost before you code.

svg.text: Negative numbers break sliding windows (use prefix sums); weights break BFS (use Dijkstra).
